capital.evidence_quote: Port of Spain is the capital city and main administrative hub of Trinidad and Tobago

sources.title: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago

currency.evidence_quote: The Trinidad and Tobago Dollar (TTD, TT$) is the official currency; floats at approx. 6.8 TT$ to 1 USD

timezone.evidence_quote: Trinidad and Tobago observes Atlantic Standard Time UTC-4 year-round without daylight saving

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential single-phase electricity across the nation is 115V 60 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Alternating current power grid operating frequency is 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall outlets standardly accept North American Type A and Type B plugs with two flat pins

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 or 555 for emergency police response across Trinidad and Tobago

sources.title: Ministry of Health Trinidad and Tobago

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 811 for emergency medical services and national ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 990 for emergency fire and rescue services

tourist_police.evidence_quote: TOPS tourist police officers patrol Maracas Bay, Port of Spain, and Tobago beaches via 999

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Port of Spain ve Laventille bölgelerinde suç oranları nedeniyle dikkatli olunmalıdır; Tobago adası tatil köyleri huzurlu ve güvenlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise increased caution due to violent crime in Port of Spain; resort areas on Tobago are much safer.
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht wegen Kriminalität in Port of Spain; die Ferienregionen auf Tobago sind deutlich sicherer.
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте повышенную осторожность в Порт-оф-Спейн; курортные зоны острова Тобаго спокойны и безопасны.
advisory_headline.es: Actúe con mayor cautela en Puerto España por delincuencia; la isla de Tobago es un destino vacacional tranquilo.

regional_warnings.area: Laventille, Beetham, Sea Lots, and Morvant in Port of Spain

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Trinidad and Tobago reach approximately 42.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds exceed 98.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: bmobile (TSTT) and Digicel provide 4G/LTE prepaid SIMs at Piarco International Airport (POS). Inter-island ferries and flights (Caribbean Airlines) connect Trinidad and Tobago multiple times daily.

sources.title: Telecommunications Authority of Trinidad and Tobago (TATT)

esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid cellular registration requires valid passport verification under national telecom regulations

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 55%), Hinduism (approx. 18%), and Islam (approx. 5%) reflecting Afro-Trinidadian and Indo-Trinidadian heritage

sources.title: Central Statistical Office Trinidad and Tobago

religion.evidence_quote: Trinidad blends Afro-Caribbean traditions with Indo-Caribbean Hindu and Muslim heritage

festivals.value: Trinidad Carnival (legendary pre-Lenten carnival), Divali (Festival of Lights), Eid-ul-Fitr, Tobago Heritage Festival
festivals.evidence_quote: Trinidad Carnival is globally famous for calypso, soca music, steelpan orchestra, and masquerade (mas)

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing camouflage patterns or military-style clothing is strictly illegal for civilians and tourists under the Summary Offences Act. Avoid unmetered street taxis; use TT RideShare or hotel-arranged transport. English is the official language.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: The importation and wearing of camouflage material is prohibited under the Defence Act

tipping.value: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants when service is not included in the bill. Tipping taxi drivers is not expected.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% tip is standard in hospitality establishments
